description.value:
A donor's face and a working slice of their memory, layered under your own skin and skull. Once per day, 10 minutes: assume the donor's face and voice (as Disguise Self, no check); +2 item bonus to Deception and to Recall Knowledge on anything the donor personally knew.

Donor: It doesn't wait for Loud to surface. Every time you wear their face, roll: on a 1 in 6, they answer a question the way they would have, not you.

cinderfall.incomplete: The once-per-day 10-minute Disguise-Self-as-a-specific-person effect, plus the Recall Knowledge bonus scoped to 'anything the donor personally knew,' both need a granted limited-use Action (same class of gap as the mutations pass's activated-disguise entries); the 1-in-6 donor-answers-instead rider is a narrative trigger with no engine hook.
